records.title: Text-to-LoRA: Instant Transformer Adaption
records.reason: Text-to-LoRA compresses and generates task adapters in one hypernetwork pass, but evaluation concerns adaptation quality rather than serving/token-generation efficiency.

records.title: Merging Context Clustering With Visual State Space Models for Medical Image Segmentation
records.reason: This is a medical-image segmentation model using visual state-space methods, not LLM inference; the Jamba lineage link is architectural only.

records.title: CATANet: Efficient Content-Aware Token Aggregation for Lightweight Image Super-Resolution
records.reason: CATANet reports nearly 2x inference speed for image super-resolution, but targets a specialized vision-SR architecture rather than LLM inference.

records.title: Generative AI and Large Language Models for Cyber Security: All Insights You Need
records.reason: This is a cybersecurity LLM survey, with no direct inference-efficiency method; multi-token-prediction linkage is only topical.

records.title: Reversible Vision Transformers
records.reason: Reversible ViTs reduce activation memory for visual recognition training; inference memory/latency gains are not established, so relation to the memory-wall lineage is weak.
